title: The Crossroads Between Two Ways
body:
We are reaching the end of this life, not our lives, but the period of our world is going to end. And now people
have mostly changed; before they gave high respect to Allah Almighty, but now they run after Shaytan.
O My Followers! I am asking from you to keep the Right Way, not the wrong way. There are only two ways:
the Right Way, which takes you to the Divinely Presence in Paradise, leading you to endless, Eternal Life, and
the wrong way! I fear to step on the wrong way. Who steps on the wrong way are followers of Shaytan, who
will be in hells along with his followers for Eternity!
There is an Eternity for good ones and another for bad ones. Try to make your names written on the tablet of
believers and good ones, and beware that your names are not written on the tablets of Shaytan and his
followers. Keep yourself! Try to keep holy orders of Allah Almighty or you will regret it! May Allah Almighty
make you on the Right Way and thankful to Him. Don't follow the ways of Shaytan! Thank you.
(Bay`a)
O our Lord! Keep Your weak servants on the Right Way, which is Your biggest grant for weak servants, and
we are trying to be even very weak servants for You, O our Lord! We never like to be shaytans, enemy of

Mankind, or to follow that one. Protect us and grant us Your forgiveness from You and Your endless blessings.
O People! Don't quarrel. Keep the Right Way you believe in, and if anyone says you are on wrong way, tell
him, “We are on the way of the Seal of Prophets (s)!" May Allah Almighty forgive us for the honor of the Seal
of Prophets (s) (Moawlana stands and sits) May Allah keep you and protect you! (...)
Yaa Qareeban ghayra ba`eed. Yaa Ghaaliban ghayra maghloob! Yaa Qareeban ghayra ba`eed! Yaa Shaahidan
ghayra ba`eed! Ant Allah, Ant Allah, Ant Allah! Allah! O Who is Near and Never Far! O Who is Victorious
and Never Defeated! You are Allah, You are Allah, You are Allah! Allahuma, yaa Rabbee, protect us from a
bad end.
In Iran, Imam Ghazali (q) said, “This is the era where silence is necessary. (Stay in) the homes. Leave the
matters of the (outside) public to their Lord.” Yaa Rabbee. What has to happen must happen...
Amaan yaa Rabbee, amaan yaa Rabbee, yaa Allah! Yaa Ghaaliban ghayra maghloob, yaa Ghaaliban ghayra
maghloob, yaa Ghaaliban ghayra maghloob! O Who Defeats and is Never Defeated! You are Allah, Ant Allah!
Fatihah.
